executiveSummary.role: Chief Product Officer, Technical Lead & Growth Architect
executiveSummary.cycleObjective: Deconstruct and codify the 197x GSC Growth Engine from real-world scaling data (29K to 2.62M impressions, 142 to 28.8K clicks in 3 months) into ConvertSheet's autonomous daily automation architecture. Codified the 4-layer scaling framework in docs/automation/growth-automation-protocol.md, updated Google AdSense compliance disclosures in privacy/page.tsx and public/ads.txt, published AI iframe embed documentation in llms.txt & llms-full.txt, and integrated automated structured data, hub-and-spoke link, and title length checks into scripts/audit-pages.js with 100% pass rate across all 935 pages.

layersEnforced.layer: Layer 1: Competitor Gap Theft & Long-Tail Keyword Mining
layersEnforced.mechanism: Autonomous scanning of GSC for positions 10-70 with >50 impressions and competitor thin-content gaps. Programmatic preset registration with pre-populated initialValues, answerSummary for AI Overviews, responsive Markdown comparison tables, and 4-6 citable FAQs.

layersEnforced.layer: Layer 2: Algorithmic CTR Engineering (1.1% to 4%+ Multiplier)
layersEnforced.mechanism: Enforcing Power Title Tag architecture ([Exact Search Intent] (2026) — [Key Number / Comparison] [Power Modifier]), bold first-sentence answers for Position 0 AI Overviews, and JSON-LD FAQPage & Speakable schemas.

The First-Two-Paragraphs Rule: every editorial post must hyperlink to its attached calculation tool within the first 1,000 characters with exact-match anchor text. Full bidirectional cluster linking eliminating orphaned pages.

layersEnforced.layer: Layer 4: Dwell-Time & User Retention Moat (Killing Bounce Rate)
layersEnforced.mechanism: 100% in-browser WASM zero-knowledge calculation, dual synchronized inputs (numeric + slider), branded SheetJS .xlsx exports with recalculation links, and sticky mobile summary bars (<640px) with 44px minimum touch targets.
